Interventional or Pilot Study Planning Outline

Use with your mentor to develop a feasible study. This is an educational planning aid, not an approved IRB protocol or a substitute for current institutional templates.

Click a shaded field to replace its prompt. Edits stay in this page only and reset on refresh. Use Print / Save as PDF to retain your work. Use nonconfidential planning text.

· Project Examples Library

Purpose and Primary Outcome

[Specify whether the study targets feasibility, safety, or efficacy. Choose an outcome and conclusion proportionate to the design and sample.]

Population and Recruitment

[Eligibility; setting; recruitment pool and rate; consent process; timeline and resources.]

Intervention and Comparator

[What is delivered, by whom, dose/intensity, schedule, comparator, adherence assessment, and permitted co-interventions.]

Assignment and Measurement

[Allocation method; randomization/concealment if used; blinding if feasible; timing; primary/secondary outcomes and data quality.]

Feasibility and Analysis

[Sample rationale; feasibility thresholds if relevant; estimand; analysis population; uncertainty; attrition/missingness; limits on efficacy claims.]

Safety and Oversight

[Actual anticipated risks; adverse-event assessment and reporting; oversight responsibilities; stopping/escalation criteria; monitoring appropriate to the intervention and risk.]

Approvals and Submission

[Required IRB, institutional, sponsor and regulatory determinations as applicable. Use the current official LSU Health Interventional Study template; this outline supplies no approved safety or regulatory language.]
